description: This file defines the implementation of the DobbySpecGenerator class, which generates container runtime specifications for applications, including configuration of mounts, environment variables, plugins, and resource limits. It is part of a plugin namespace within the WPEFramework project and interacts with various system and application configurations.

classes.name: DobbySpecGenerator
classes.description: A class responsible for generating container runtime specifications based on application and runtime configurations, including setting up mounts, environment variables, plugins, and resource limits.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Generates the container specification JSON string based on application and runtime configurations, optionally reading from a pre-existing spec file.

methods.name: getWorkingDir
methods.description: Determines the working directory for the container based on application configuration and runtime parameters.

methods.name: createEnvVars
methods.description: Creates environment variable array for the container based on application and runtime configurations.

methods.name: createMounts
methods.description: Creates the list of filesystem mounts for the container based on configuration.

methods.name: createBindMount
methods.description: Creates a bind mount specification for source and destination paths with specified mount flags.

methods.name: createResourceManagerMount
methods.description: Creates a mount for the resource manager socket if available.

methods.name: encodeURL
methods.description: Encodes a URL string using libcurl's escape function.

methods.name: initialiseIonHeapsJson
methods.description: Initializes the JSON configuration for Ion memory heaps based on application configuration.

methods.name: getSysMemoryLimit
methods.description: Calculates the system memory limit for the container based on configuration and runtime parameters.

methods.name: getGPUMemoryLimit
methods.description: Calculates the GPU memory limit for the container based on configuration and runtime parameters.

methods.name: getVpuEnabled
methods.description: Determines whether VPU (Video Processing Unit) acceleration should be enabled for the application.

methods.name: getCpuCores
methods.description: Returns a string representing the CPU cores to be allocated to the container based on application configuration.

methods.name: createRdkPlugins
methods.description: Creates the RDK plugin configuration JSON object for the container.
